items.reviewNote: After losing the crew, the travelers find it again. All three existing lost-object/recovered-contact banks and both encounter/recognition siblings were compared. Share the broad proper retrouver meaning, with a new plural past surface bank rather than a plural- or tense-only meaning. Each complete plural predicate fits ils le; rediscovery differs from losing, abandoning or hiding.

The travelers restore the lost crew/boat group to order after the vessel’s fall. No proper French rajuster lemma or earlier plan was found. Prepare the verb’s broad put-back-in-order meaning, without asserting a technical seam repair or treating rajuster as the noun adjustment. All four complete plural predicates fit ils le; the restoration clue selects rajustèrent over disorder, abandonment or damage.

Quoiqu’il introduces the concession that the Sirian speaks kindly despite inward irritation. The published historical quoy que banks and earlier joined quoique bank were read. Share the proper quoique conjunction and its concessive meaning, preserving the contracted subject in this surface; historical spelling and subject person do not create senses. Before import normalize the old separated-spelling-only definition to the full modern/historical conjunction. All four clause introducers admit fût fâché; concession differs from anteriority, absence and purpose.

Fût un peu fâché predicates a state of irritation, rather than reporting a passive event of someone angering him. Académie9 explicitly registers fâché as an adjective. Neither a French adjective owner nor a fâcher plan exists in the searched families; prepare the proper adjective lemma, not an unowned past-participle sense under the verb. The four masculine singular adjective predicates fit il est and distinguish displeasure from joy, indifference or relief.

Eussent has the noun phrase un orgueil as its object: it is lexical possession of an attribute/emotion, not the exact published compound auxiliary. The auxiliary bank and all current lexical avoir banks were read. Share the broad existing possession meaning with a context-specific surface bank; the existing mixed possession/auxiliary definition still requires whole-family reconciliation before import. All four subjunctive plural verbs accept un tel orgueil; the stated possession clue selects eussent without a mood-only sense.

Un orgueil presque infiniment grand attributes excessive self-importance to the tiny humans, not satisfaction with an achievement. No French orgueil owner or earlier plan was found. Prepare the proper masculine noun with its conceit/pride meaning. All four middle alternatives are masculine singular after son; the explicit excessive self-importance clue selects orgueil over respect, courage or calm.

Un beau livre praises the promised book’s qualities; its later blankness gives the episode irony without an irony-only lexical meaning. The aesthetically beautiful, broad fine-quality and avoir beau families and every three-band bank were read. Share the broad pleasing-by-qualities sense. Prepare this separate book-quality surface bank because the exact existing broad bank teaches an explicitly ironic result and does not supply a neutral quality clue; no new scene-specific sense is created.

Le livre de philosophie concerns fundamental questions about reality and knowledge, matching the preceding debate. No proper French philosophie lemma or earlier plan was found. Prepare the noun for the intellectual field, not a particular philosophical school or a generic personal attitude. All four alternatives are feminine singular after la; the fundamental-inquiry clue selects philosophie rather than plant cultivation, cooking or navigation.

Écrit describes the promised book as a composed/traced text, modified by adverbial menu. It is a verbal participle under proper écrire, not the substantive un écrit. The broad write/compose family and both complete existing surface banks were read and compared with the other representation-of-words family. Share the generic écrire meaning with new surface questions; gender and participle status do not create a separate meaning.

Écrit fort menu describes the small size of the writing, not a meal list or a slender noun referent. Académie7 explicitly places écrire menu under adverbial menu; Académie9 also labels this use adverbial. The complete existing menuë adjective bank was read. Prepare proper adverbial menu ownership and a fine/small manner meaning, comparing the adjacent adjective core without assigning this invariant adverb to the published adjective lemma. All four adverbs fit il écrit; only menu states tiny lettering.

Pour leur usage means the book is intended to serve its recipients, not a habitual social custom. The earlier plural usages/customs plan and all three bands were read. Share that proper French usage noun owner while preparing the distinct use/utilization meaning; singular number alone is not the reason for a new meaning. All four middle alternatives are masculine singular after leur and the serving-purpose clue selects usage over purchase, sale or storage.

Verraient le bout des choses promises that the humans would discover or understand the ultimate explanation in the book, not merely see a spatial edge. The complete checking/find-out family and earlier voyez understanding bank were read; share that ascertainment meaning under voir, broadening its existing check-only definition to the reviewed find-out/recognition core only after whole-family impact review. Conditional inflection does not create a sense. The complete bout des choses span keeps its own phrase bank without absorbing this verb.

Effectivement confirms that the promised volume was actually handed over. No French effectivement owner or earlier plan was found. Prepare the confirmation/in-fact adverb meaning, not the false-friend efficiently or a new event-specific sense. All four sentence adverbs fit the introductory position; confirmation contrasts with regret, reversal or uncertainty.

Son départ names the Sirian’s leaving, before which he gives the book. No French départ noun or earlier plan was found. Prepare the generic departure meaning rather than a journey-only sense. All four alternatives départ/retour/repos/séjour are masculine singular nouns after son; the explicit leaving clue selects départ over return, rest or staying.

Académie des sciences names an institution through the common plural noun for fields of systematic knowledge. The existing science bank and all three questions were read. Share the generic science/systematic-knowledge meaning, rather than a proper-name-only or plural-only sense. All four alternatives are feminine plural nouns after les; methodical study and research select sciences over rumors, legends or superstition.

Je m’en étais bien douté reports that the secretary had suspected or anticipated the blank result. Académie1762 distinguishes pronominal conjecture from ordinary uncertainty. The existing se douter/suspect meaning and all three stored banks were read, alongside earlier nonpronominal doute/doutait banks. Share the existing suspicion meaning; explicitly normalize its se douter owner to proper douter after whole-family impact review, preserving the sense and mastery. All four pronominal participles fit je m’en étais; anticipation contrasts with certainty, memory or joy.

The giant names tiny people who nevertheless possess vast pride. This substantivized masculine plural phrase differs from the singular abstract domain l’infiniment petit reviewed in VI. All four complete noun phrases are masculine plural and fit appelle. The full span prevents an isolated article plus an unrelated adjective from becoming duplicated vocabulary identities. The earlier V substantive petits plan and all three banks were read: they denote the same tiny beings. Before import, correct that nominal ownership away from the adjective lemma, share the planned noun meaning, and reconcile the two complete spans without a new meaning or duplicate mastery. Package07 re-read the complete earlier three-band bank unchanged for these exact phrase uses; preserve whole-expression mastery and suppress only exact components before import.

reviewBasis: Full source thought units, independently written meaning clues, every middle alternative, noun number and agreement, distinct meanings and explicit ownership dependencies were individually inspected. Structural checks verify revision and coverage, never editorial approval.
